scope.writer: native MEMIT-form mean-key ridge with existing H

method.loss: Actual materialized candidate weights act on ALL tokens in the same causal native NLL/current||entry KL forward; no subject-only masked/v loss, routed gradient or frozen-upper substitution.
method.writer: R_l=a_l*u_l; actual lower candidate write -> fresh upper rewrite-only native nested mean K -> raw A=15000*C0+H -> whole-B ridge P=solve(A+KK.T,K) -> U=R P.T and fresh Q. KL rows stay in actual loss but not writer K/H mean. No absolute-z tracking/divisor, inverse-realization, projected/exact/AlphaEdit/L2 writer or CD context-equality constraints.
method.gradient: Complete lowerR -> upperK/P/U/Q and task gradient including all requests and zero blocks. Preserve native C0 FP32 count division/CPUFP32 H then FP64 geometry and raw nonsymmetric A semantics; no hidden symmetrization/jitter. Cost VJP includes A+A.T/G+G.T unless symmetric equivalence is established. Actual loss uses FP32 cast/add materialization, ideal Q and effective terminal Q separately.
method.objective: SUM native task + lambda_Q*SUM Q is smooth F. G=SUM(.5/a_lr)*||u_lr||, handled ONLY by prox; no norm gradient double count or shared radius/EfficiencyAdam/a_star normalization. Per-block .75 native ball; all layers remain eligible/reenter.
method.solver: Full-gradient proximal BB1/nonmonotone Armijo exactly canonical. Initial eta0=min c/max block||g0|| with allzero special branch eta0/tau NA. BB1 positive finite curvature else last accepted eta, safeguards1e-6..1e6 eta0. Accepted window5, sigma1e-4, shrink.5; rejected trial forward-only and never committed. At most50 logical candidate evaluations including initial/rejected,24 accepted updates,25 full gradients(initial1+accepted1). Last accepted gradient reused for terminal mapping, no extra26th gradient; terminal does not mean skip its already-required gradient. tau=eta0 fixed, normalized mapping threshold1e-3; no all-J<.05 main stop.
method.fixed_budget: Finite feasible identity-consistent nonstationary accepted payload may commit with BUDGET_NOT_STATIONARY; LINE_SEARCH_BUDGET/NUMERICAL_STALL distinguished. Calibration/nonfinite/solve/identity errors are not fixed-budget permission.
method.commit: Copy exactly final ACCEPTED FP32 payload used by actual loss; no recompute solve or duplicate add, no last rejected candidate. Native final rewrite mean H append once/layer after all writes, qualified final-key reuse only. W/H/RNG/context/cursor RAM transaction rollback, observer nonmutation, fresh teachers/anchors/factors each next batch; BB memory reset each batch, lambda fixed.

calibration.reference: Once for main B1, original native L8 anchor compute_z independently for same100 requests, original Adam/lr/norm/clamp/earlyexit/max25. Store actual returned delta only at L8, other eligible R0. No boundary expansion, reference commit or H append, no new baseline chain.
calibration.actual: Evaluate reference using SAME all-token causal MEMIT objective; t=-<grad_u F_task,u_ref>, n=G(u_ref), d=<grad_u Q,u_ref>; check d=2Q for this one nonzero layer. lambda_Q=(t-n)/d.
calibration.validity: Finite t/n/d and difference, d>0, t>n, finite positive lambda after arithmetic. Preserve operands, precision/cancellation/cap contacts/task-Q adjoints/hashes. No abs/epsilon/clip/default/zero fallback, no heldout-based reference or price change.
calibration.failure: CALIBRATION_NONFINITE / CALIBRATION_NO_VALID_ENERGY / CALIBRATION_NO_POSITIVE_PRICE as defined; preserve raw and report, do not start nonzero main with invalidprice. Genuine native all-noop only permits documented noop batch/Honce and pendingprice at first nontrivialbatch; failed fit returningzero is not genuine noop.
calibration.cost: Reference fits, actual task/Q gradient channels/replay/solve and qualification are separately counted AND included total cost. No claim of zero calibration overhead. Once valid, immutable price all20batch; no strengthmatching/sweep.
